register: Ibn Rajab, Taqrīr al-Qawāʿid: apparent contradictions inside his book and across the bank, resolved by the bank
method: As in sadi.json: two qawāʿid, each read without its qayd, rule opposite ways on a shared case, and the pair is resolved by Usul.resolve and al-Saʿdī's rules of reading (Q29, Q57). The qayd is always Ibn Rajab's own sentence in the pinned witness. A rule of another work in the bank is named work:number.

pairs.case_en: An act done on a belief later shown wrong: Q66 (as read) upholds it only where a valid basis exists in fact; Q6 upholds it unless another's right attaches or he was negligent. With no valid basis, Q66 holds not ṣaḥīḥ what Q6 upholds; with another's right attached, Q6 undoes what Q66 upholds.
pairs.qayd_en: Q66 speaks only where the true basis exists; elsewhere Q6.

author.excerpt_ar: ثم تبين خطؤه فيه وأن السبب المعتمد غيره وهو موجود

pairs.case_en: The original found while performing the substitute: al-Saʿdī's Q28 allows the substitute only when the original is impossible, so he switches; Ibn Rajab's Q7 lets one who began a general concession continue.
pairs.qayd_en: Q28 governs the substitute instituted from necessity; the general concession stands (Q7's first type).

author.excerpt_ar: الضرب الثاني: أن يكون المتلبس به إنما شرع ضرورة للعجز عن الأصل وتعذره
فهذا يلزمه الانتقال إلى الأصل عند القدرة عليه

pairs.case_en: An excepted benefit of uncertain extent, e.g. a waqf excepting its benefit for the founder's life: Q32 upholds it; Q33, as read, holds not ṣaḥīḥ an exception of uncertain extent unless the law makes it.
pairs.qayd_en: Where the transfer already bears an uncertain period (waqf, manumission), Q32 governs; elsewhere Q33.

author.excerpt_ar: لأن جهالة المدة هنا لا تؤثر فإنها لا تزيد على جهالة مدة كل بطن بالنسبة إلى من بعده

pairs.case_en: An oath (ḥalaf: «لو حلف لا يقف في هذا الماء») not to stand in this water while it runs: Q1, as read, reckons running water jirya by jirya, so he cannot stand in it; al-Saʿdī's Q9 measures by custom, which counts the river one body.
pairs.qayd_en: Oaths are measured by custom (Q9); outside oaths, Q1's jirya.

pairs.case_en: Two find al-manī in a garment they share, not knowing whose: Q14 (its second riwāya) attaches the certain breach, the aṣl having ended in one of them; Q15 keeps each presumption and ignores its consequence for another.
pairs.qayd_en: Taken together in one ruling (one leading the other in prayer, both slave-women in one ownership), Q14; each alone, Q15.

author.excerpt_ar: فينظر إليهما مجتمعين في حكم يتعلق باجتماعهما
